study.citation: GAOUE OG, TICKTIN T (2010) Effects of Harvest of Nontimber Forest Products and Ecological Differences between Sites on the Demography of African Mahogany. Conservation Biology 24:605-614. doi:10.1111/j.1523-1739.2009.01345.x
study.notes: Six high-harvest vs six low-harvest populations (population-level mean matrices 2004-2006). Harvest status is not randomised: ecoregion and site differences are confounded.

design_caveat: Harvested vs unharvested populations differ in site/period too: contrast is not a causal effect estimate.
n0_basis: stable stage distribution × 100 (hypothetical; normalised index, not a local stock)
